q: The company decided to ___ the project due to lack of funds.
e: abandon 放弃(计划/项目/希望)。线索: 缺资金→放弃项目。abolish 废除(法律/制度); resign 辞职。搭配: abandon the plan / abandon hope。

q: Plants ___ water through their roots.
e: absorb 吸收(水分/光线/知识)。线索: 植物通过根___水。digest 消化(食物/信息); attract 吸引。搭配: be absorbed in 专心于(高频)。

q: The witness gave an ___ account of what happened that night.
e: accurate 准确的、精确的。线索: 目击者描述必须准确。adequate 足够的; eventual 最终的。搭配: an accurate description / accurate information。

q: She ___ a good knowledge of French by living in Paris for years.
e: acquire 习得、获得(知识/技能)。线索: 住巴黎多年→习得法语。形近: require 需要; inquire 询问。搭配: acquire knowledge/skills。

q: It took him several months to ___ to the cold climate in the north.
e: adapt to 适应(新环境)。线索: 花了几个月___寒冷气候。形近: adopt 采纳/收养。搭配: adapt to the climate / adapt the novel for the screen 改编。

q: Make sure the food supply is ___ for all the guests at the party.
e: adequate 足够的、充分的。线索: 食物供给要够所有客人。elegant 优雅的; equivalent 等价的。搭配: adequate for / adequate supply。

q: We ___ that online sales will double by the end of next year.
e: anticipate 预期、预料。线索: 明年底线上销售翻倍是对未来的预期。形近: participate 参加(participate in)。搭配: anticipate that + 从句 / anticipate doing。

q: It was ___ to everyone that she was upset by the bad news.
e: apparent 明显的、显而易见的。线索: 每个人都看得出她难过。近义: obvious / evident。形近: appropriate 得体的; approximate 大约的。搭配: It is apparent that...

q: Winter is ___ and the days are getting shorter and shorter.
e: approach 临近、接近(v.)。线索: 白昼变短→冬天临近。approach 还有名词高频义: 方法(an approach to)。搭配: the approach of winter / a new approach to teaching。

q: Casual clothes are not ___ for a formal job interview.
e: appropriate 恰当的、得体的。线索: 便装对正式面试不得体。搭配: appropriate for/to the occasion。名词 appropriation 挪用(超纲)。

q: Tickets for the concert are ___ at the box office or online.
e: available 可获得的、有空的。线索: 门票在售票处或网上可获得。搭配: available for / available to sb(高频)。available 人作主语=有空: Are you available tomorrow?

q: Language differences are often a ___ to effective communication.
e: barrier 障碍、屏障。线索: 语言差异阻碍交流。搭配: a barrier to sth(固定搭配, to 是介词后接名词)。近义: obstacle。

q: Regular exercise ___ your health in many ways.
e: benefit 有益于(v.)。线索: 经常锻炼对健康___。搭配: benefit from 从...中获益(高频); for the benefit of 为了...的利益。

q: The government launched a ___ to encourage people to save energy.
e: campaign (社会)运动、活动。线索: 政府发起节能___。搭配: launch a campaign 发起运动; a campaign against smoking。

q: She is fully ___ of solving the problem on her own.
e: capable of doing sth 有能力做某事。陷阱: able 后面只能接 to do(able to solve), 不能接 of! 这就是搭配考点。competent/qualified 后也接 to do 或 for。

q: Under no ___ should you share your password with others.
e: under no circumstances 决不、无论如何不(固定短语)。考点: 否定短语放句首时句子要部分倒装(Under no circumstances should you...)。

q: Dozens of companies are ___ for the same government contract.
e: compete for 为争夺...而竞争。线索: 几十家公司争夺同一份合同。搭配: compete with/against sb for sth。名词: competition / competitor。

q: I cannot ___ on my study with all this noise going on outside.
e: concentrate on 集中注意力于。线索: 噪音让我无法___学习。近义: focus on。名词 concentration。

q: I am ___ that our team will win the championship this year.
e: confident (that) 确信的、有信心的。搭配: be confident of sth / be confident that + 从句。名词 confidence 自信; 形近 confidential 机密的。

q: He lost his job as a ___ of the serious mistake he made.
e: as a consequence of 由于...的结果(高频短语)。线索: 犯大错→丢工作的结果。形近: sequence 顺序; 近义: result / outcome。形容词: consequent(超纲)。

q: The research project requires a ___ amount of time and money.
e: considerable 相当大的、可观的。线索: 项目需要相当多的时间金钱。经典形近陷阱: considerate 体贴的。搭配: a considerable number/amount of。

q: Many volunteers ___ their spare time to the community center.
e: contribute...to 把...贡献给。三胞胎辨析: contribute 贡献 / distribute 分发 / attribute 把...归因于(attribute A to B)。名词 contribution。

q: Is this Saturday ___ for you to come over and discuss the plan?
e: convenient for sb 对某人方便。陷阱: 中文说 你方便吗, 英语不说 Are you convenient, 要说 Is it convenient for you / Is Saturday convenient for you?

q: Sleep plays a ___ role in memory and learning.
e: crucial 至关重要的。线索: 睡眠对记忆和学习的作用至关重要。搭配: play a crucial role in(写作高频句型)。近义: vital / essential。形近: cruel 残忍的。

q: Sales of the product began to ___ after the holiday season ended.
e: decline 下降、衰退; 还有高频义: 婉拒(decline an invitation)。线索: 节后销售___。形近: declare 宣布; decorate 装饰。

q: The store ___ groceries to your door free of charge.
e: deliver 递送(包裹/货物)。熟词僻义: deliver a speech 发表演讲(高频)。名词 delivery 快递。

q: It is hard to ___ the twin sisters from each other.
e: distinguish A from B / distinguish between A and B 区分、辨别。线索: 双胞胎难以___。形近: disturb 打扰。形容词: distinctive 有特色的 / distinct 清晰的、不同的。

q: The new machine is far more ___ than the old one, saving both time and energy.
e: efficient 高效的(强调过程效率高, 省时省力)。经典辨析: effective 有效的(强调结果达到目的)。线索: saving both time and energy 指向效率。搭配: an efficient worker / energy-efficient。

q: Clean water is ___ for the survival of all living things.
e: essential 必不可少的。线索: 干净的水对生存___。搭配: be essential to/for sth(高频)。近义: vital / necessary。

q: There has been a ___ improvement in his English since he started practicing daily.
e: gradual 逐渐的、循序渐进的。线索: 每天练习→英语逐步提高。搭配: a gradual change/increase/improvement。副词 gradually。形近: graceful 优雅的 / grateful 感激的。

q: In the meeting, the manager will ___ the safety concerns raised by the workers.
e: 熟词僻义: address 处理、解决(问题)= deal with。你熟悉的是地址, 四级考动词! 搭配: address the issue/problem/question。

q: This color really ___ you — you should buy the dress.
e: 三胞胎: fit 指大小尺寸合身; suit 指颜色款式适合、衬托人; match 指两物之间相配(The shoes match the dress)。线索: 颜色适合你→suits。

q: The lecture ___ for three hours, and nobody left early.
e: 熟词僻义: last 作动词=持续(The rain lasted two days)。你熟悉的是最后的(形容词)。maintain 维持/保养; lengthen 加长(及物)。

q: Can you ___ the difference between the original painting and the copy?
e: 熟词僻义: tell 分辨、区分= distinguish。搭配: tell A from B / tell the difference。say/speak/talk 都没有分辨义。

q: The school has ___ a new teaching method to improve class efficiency.
e: 铁三角: adopt 采纳/收养 / adapt 适应/改编 / adept 形容词 熟练的。线索: 学校___新教学方法→采纳 adopt。

q: The new policy will ___ thousands of workers in this industry.
e: affect 是动词 影响; effect 是名词 影响(have an effect on)。本题缺动词→affect。effort 努力(n.); offer 提供。考点: 词性辨析。

q: The ___ reason for the delay was the bad weather, not the traffic.
e: principal 主要的( adj.)/校长(n.); principle 原则、原理(n.)。记法: principal 里有个 pal 伙伴→校长是你的主要伙伴; principle 以 -le 结尾像 rule 规则→原则。

q: The sun ___ in the east and sets in the west.
e: rise 不及物 升起(sun/moon/price rise); raise 及物 举起/抚养(raise your hand/raise children); arise 不及物 产生(问题出现 problems arise); arouse 及物 唤醒/激发(arouse interest)。

q: Please ___ the book on the desk before you leave the room.
e: lay 及物 放置(过去式 laid); lie 不及物 躺(躺: lie-lay-lain)/说谎(lie-lied-lied)。本题宾语 the book→需要及物动词 lay。四级最爱考的三态变化。

q: I was delighted to ___ their invitation to the graduation ceremony.
e: receive 收到(客观收到, 不一定接受); accept 接受(主观愿意)。我可以 receive 一份邀请却 choose not to accept it。线索: 欣然地→主观接受。

q: I could not remember the spelling, so I ___ the word in the dictionary.
e: look up 查(词典/资料/生词); look for 寻找(某人某物); look after 照顾; look into 调查(事故/原因)。线索: in the dictionary 决定是查词。

q: The residents could no longer ___ the noise from the bar next door.
o: put up with;;put off;;put out;;put away
e: put up with 忍受 = tolerate, 后接被忍受的对象。put off 推迟; put out 扑灭; put away 收好。could no longer 是忍受类题的常见信号。

q: After the old CEO retired, his daughter ___ the company.
e: take over 接管(公司/职责)。take up 开始从事/占据(时间空间); take in 吸收/欺骗/收留; take off 起飞/脱下。宾语是 company→接管。

q: The football match had to be ___ because of the heavy rain.
e: call off 取消 = cancel。call on 拜访某人/号召; call up 打电话/使想起; call for 需要(这活儿需要耐心)。被大雨___→取消。

q: She was ___ by her grandparents in a small mountain town.
e: bring up 抚养(孩子)/提出(话题), 被动 was brought up 由…养大。bring about 导致; bring out 使显现/出版; bring down 使下降。

q: We have ___ the printer paper, so I cannot print the report now.
o: run out of;;run into;;run over;;run after
e: run out of 用完(主语是人)。主语是物时用 run out: The paper has run out。run into 偶遇/撞上; run over 碾过/超时。

q: Nothing can ___ the time I wasted in the last term.
o: make up for;;make out;;make for;;make it
e: make up for 弥补(损失/时间)。make up 组成/编造/化妆; make out 辨认出; make for 有助于/朝…走去。宾语是 wasted time→弥补。

q: The team ___ to prove the theory within two years.
e: set out to do sth 着手做某事; set about doing sth 也表着手, 但后面只能接动名词。空后是不定式 to prove→只能选 set out。四级常考这一刀切的区别。

q: He is quite ___ of solving the problem on his own.
e: be capable of doing sth 有能力做。be able to do(接 to do 不接 of); it is possible for sb to do(形式主语); be suitable for 适合。介词 of 锁定 capable。

q: I insisted on ___ the discussion until we reached an agreement.
e: insist on 中的 on 是介词, 后接名词或动名词。介词/连词后接 doing 的高频词还有: look forward to, be used to, pay attention to, mind, avoid, finish。

q: We are looking forward to ___ from you soon.
e: look forward to 的 to 是介词→接动名词。hear from sb 收到某人来信。这是四级填空/改错里出错率最高的一项, 千万别写成 to hear。

q: 下面哪一句有语病(中式英语)?
o: We discussed about the plan for two hours.;;We talked about the plan for two hours.;;We had a discussion about the plan.;;We discussed the plan for two hours.
e: discuss 是及物动词, 后面不加 about; talk 不及物才需要 about。同类易错: marry sb(不加 to), reach a place(不加 to), enter the room(不加 into), explain sth to sb。

q: The manager is ___ for the safety of all the passengers.
e: be responsible for sth 对某事负责; be responsible to sb 向某人负责。be likely to do 很可能; be guilty of 有…罪; be busy with/in 忙于。

q: Who is ___ the project this month?
o: in charge of;;in the charge of;;under charge of;;at charge of
e: in charge of 负责(主语是人)。主语是物时反过来: The project is in the charge of Mr Li(由李先生负责)。本题主语是 Who 问人→in charge of。

q: He broke the glass ___, for he was angry at us.
e: on purpose 故意 = deliberately; by accident 偶然 = by chance。线索 for he was angry 给出动机→故意。in vain 白费力气。

q: The meeting was held on Monday ___ of Wednesday.
e: instead of + 名词 代替/而不是。rather 要配 than(rather than), 且不能接 of。空后已有 of→只能填 instead。

q: She spends two hours ___ the piano every day.
e: spend time (in) doing sth 花时间做某事, 动词用 -ing。只接 doing 的高频动词: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, practise, suggest, consider, delay。

q: I could not help ___ when I heard the funny news.
e: cannot help doing sth 忍不住做某事。区分: cannot but do 不得不做(后接动词原形); cannot help it 没法子。本题空在 could not help 之后→laughing。

q: The old man is blind ___ his own shortcomings.
e: be blind to 对…视而不见。to 结尾的高频搭配: be new to(陌生), be similar to, be superior to(优于), be inferior to(差于), come close to。

q: He was accused ___ stealing money from the office. (只填一个介词)
e: accuse sb of sth 指控某人某事, 被动 be accused of。同类 of: warn sb of, remind sb of, suspect sb of, be proud of。注意 accuse 配 of, charge 配 with。

q: I ___ my homework last night, so I could watch the film.
e: 有明确的过去时间状语(last night/yesterday/in 2020)只能用一般过去时。现在完成时不能与明确的过去时间连用, 这是四级时题的第一考点。

q: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___ the shop.
e: by the time + 一般过去时, 主句用过去完成时(过去的过去)。先跑后到→小偷离开在前, 用 had left。

q: This time tomorrow I ___ in the plane to Shanghai.
o: will be sitting;;will have sat;;am sitting;;would sit
e: this time tomorrow 指向将来某一时刻正在进行的动作→will be doing。will have done 表到将来某刻已完成, 本句没有完成意味。

q: The book ___ I borrowed from the library is out of print now.
e: 先行词是物且关系词在从句中作 borrowed 的宾语→that/which。what 不能引导定语从句(它本身已含先行词意义)。作主语时不可省, 作宾语时可省。

q: He has a sister, ___ is studying abroad now.
e: 有逗号的是非限制性定语从句, 不能用 that。关系词在从句作主语→who; whom 只能作宾语; whose 要接名词。

q: The manager ___ assistant I met at the hotel was very kind.
e: 空后有名词 assistant, 表所属关系(经理的助理)→whose。whose 既可指人也可指物: the building whose roof is red。

q: This is the cafe ___ we first met.
e: 从句 we first met 主谓完整、不缺宾语, 需要的是地点状语→关系副词 where。若从句缺宾语(This is the cafe ___ we visited)才用 which/that。判断口诀: 从句缺成分用 which/that, 不缺用 where/when/why。

q: ___ surprised me most was the lack of clean water.
e: 主语从句内部缺主语(令我惊讶的东西)→what = the thing which。that 引导名词性从句时只起连接作用、不充当任何成分, 因此不能填这里。

q: The news ___ our team had won the game spread quickly.
e: 从句结构完整且内容就是 news 本身→同位语从句, 用 that 且不充当成分(不可省略)。区分定语从句: The news that he told us 里 that 作 told 的宾语。

q: It was ___ a difficult problem that nobody could work it out.
e: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that; so + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + that(It was so difficult a problem that...)。空后是 a difficult problem→用 such。

q: You will never pass the exam ___ you work much harder.
e: unless = if...not 除非。本句已有 never, 若换成 if 就变成 如果你更努力就永远通不过, 逻辑反了。unless 常与否定主句搭配。

q: I wish I ___ him the truth earlier, but I kept silent.
e: wish 对过去的遗憾→过去完成 had done; 对现在的愿望→过去式; 对将来的期望→would do。earlier + but I kept silent 说明事情已过去→had told。

q: The doctor suggested that he ___ smoking at once.
o: give up;;gives up;;gave up;;will give up
e: suggest/insist/order/demand/require/advise 后的 that 从句用虚拟: (should) + 动词原形, should 常省略。注意: suggest 表暗示(他的表情 suggests that he knew)时不用虚拟。

q: ___ is no use arguing with him about this matter.
e: It is no use doing sth 是形式主语结构, it 指代后面的动名词短语。同类: It is no good/useless/worthwhile doing。

q: It was in the lab ___ we found the answer to the problem.
e: 强调句结构 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余。去掉 It was 与 that 句子仍成立(In the lab we found...)→强调句。强调地点状语也只用 that, 不用 where。

q: Not until yesterday ___ about the danger of the plan.
o: did we learn;;we learned;;we did learn;;learned we
e: Not until 置句首→主句部分倒装(把 did/have/can 等提到主语前), 从句部分不倒装。直到昨天我们才意识到→did we learn。

q: Only when the rain stopped ___ go out.
e: only + 状语从句置句首→主句部分倒装, 情态动词/助动词提到主语前。语义是 雨停之后我们才能出去→could we; had we 与空后的动词原形 go 不搭配, we could 没有倒装。

q: ___ he had arrived home when the telephone rang.
e: Hardly/Scarcely...when 与 No sooner...than 是固定配对。本题后面给的是 when→选 Hardly, 且 Hardly 置句首要求主句倒装(Hardly had he arrived)。看到 than 才选 No sooner。

q: Either the teachers or the headmaster ___ responsible for the safety of the students.
e: either...or / neither...nor / not only...but also 连接两个主语时谓语就近。紧挨谓语的是 the headmaster(单数)→is; 远处的 the teachers 是复数但不决定谓语。

q: ___ from the top of the hill, the city looks like a map.
e: 分词作状语时逻辑主语必须是主句主语 the city, 城市与看是被动关系→过去分词 Seen。用 Seeing 则主句主语得是人(Seeing..., we found...)。

q: 读一个长难句, 第一步该做什么?
o: 先定位谓语动词, 划出主谓宾或主系表;;把每个从句都逐字翻译成中文;;从最后一个词倒着读;;把所有生词查一遍
e: 长难句 = 一个主干 + 层层修饰。先找谓语(一个句子只有一个谓语动词), 主干立住后再把定语/状语/同位语折叠起来。这是所有长句题的通用第一步。

q: The report prepared by the committee last year recommends more reading time. 句中 prepared 的作用是?
o: 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 report;;全句的谓语动词;;时间状语;;宾语补足语
e: 全句谓语是 recommends, 所以 prepared 只能是非谓语: prepared by the committee last year 作后置定语修饰 the report(委员会去年准备的报告)。识别即: 动词形式多但谓语只有一个。

q: The students who finish the course that lasts two months will get a certificate. 主句主语是?
e: who 从句修饰 students, that 从句修饰 course, 层层挂定语。剥掉后主干是 The students will get a certificate(修完课的学生拿证书)。

q: The change, ___, will take effect next month.
o: as far as I can tell;;in order to;;so as to;;such as
e: 两个逗号之间是插入语, 删掉不影响主干。常见插入语: as far as I can tell(据我看), in my view, so to speak, what is more, to tell the truth。读长句时先把它们括起来。

q: It is widely believed that reading aloud helps shy students speak more confidently. 句子的真正主语是?
o: that 引导的从句;;It;;reading aloud;;shy students
e: It 是形式主语, 逻辑主语是 that reading aloud helps... 整个从句。写作里用 This is widely believed that 是错的, 必须 It is widely believed that...。

q: The fact that he lied to us shocked everyone. 画线的 that 从句是?
o: 同位语从句, 说明 fact 的具体内容;;定语从句, 修饰 fact;;原因状语从句;;结果状语从句
e: 从句 he lied to us 结构完整、且与 the fact 是同一件事→同位语从句。若是定语从句, that 必须在从句里充当成分(The fact that he mentioned 中 mentioned 缺宾语)。

q: 阅读里遇到 A is not happy any more than he is perfect, 意思是?
o: A 不幸福, 正如他并不完美(两者都不成立);;A 不再像从前那样幸福;;A 比 B 更不幸福;;A 幸福但 A 不完美
e: not...any more than = 与…一样也不…, 前后一起否定。同类难点: no more than 只(数量少), not more than 不超过, no less than 多达。

q: This rule is not true for all cases. 句中 not 否定的是?
o: all, 表部分否定: 并非所有情况都成立;;true, 表全部否定: 全都不成立;;for 这个介词;;cases 这个名词
e: not 与 all/both/every/always/完全 连用表部分否定(并非都)。要全部否定得用 none/neither/not...at all。阅读判断题里这一字之差就是错项来源。

q: 阅读中判断 it / this / they 指代什么, 最可靠的做法是?
o: 回看上一句的主语或宾语, 代入原句检验逻辑;;找离它最近的那个名词;;看中文翻译是否顺口;;查词典看该词有哪些词义
e: 指代题答案几乎总在上文(主语、宾语或整件事)。把候选项代回原句, 意思通顺且与原文一致的才是答案。只找最近名词是典型陷阱。

q: 做段落主旨题时, 最稳妥的路径是?
o: 读首末句并抓反复出现的主题词, 再排除过窄与过宽的选项;;逐句精翻全文再总结;;原文出现过的句子就是主旨;;含数字最多的选项最可信
e: 主旨两大干扰: 只覆盖某一句(过窄)和讲得比原文多(过宽)。首末句 + 复现词是定位主线最快的方法, 数字细节几乎从不是主旨。

q: 猜生词词义时最应依据什么?
o: 上下文的逻辑线索词(转折/因果/并列/解释);;词根词缀可以唯一决定;;词典里的第一条释义;;自己的经验联想
e: 四级考语境义: but/however/yet 给反义线索, and/or/just as 给同义线索, that is/namely/in other words 给解释, 破折号与同位语也常在释义。词根词缀只是辅助。

q: 细节题与推断题的正确选项通常长什么样?
o: 原文信息的同义改写(paraphrase);;与原文一模一样的整句;;含 all/only/never/must 的绝对表述;;文章里没提但很合理的常识
e: 正确答案多是改写(换词/换语态/换顺序); 照抄原句常是偷换细节的陷阱; 含绝对词的选项多为错项; 合理常识若原文无依据属过度推断。

q: 阅读中破折号后面的内容一般起什么作用?
o: 解释说明或补充, 可先跳过不影响主干;;表示强烈的否定;;引出与前文相反的结论;;标记说话人换了话题
e: dash 后多为解释(同位语), 与非限制性定语从句、括号功能相同。第一遍读长句时可直接括起来跳过, 做题需要细节再回来。

q: Reading is to the mind what water is to fish. 这句话的意思是?
o: 阅读之于心灵, 就像水之于鱼(类比关系);;阅读比心灵更重要;;阅读和鱼都需要水;;读书的人像鱼一样离不开水
e: A is to X what B is to Y 是固定类比句型, 读作 A 对于 X 犹如 B 对于 Y。写作里用它替代 simple 的 and, 是加分句。

q: 遇到含三个以上从句的超长句, 最有效的处理办法是?
o: 按 that/which/when/because 等连词切段, 逐段判断修饰对象再重组;;从头到尾快速读三遍;;先把所有生词背完再读;;只读最后一小段
e: 切分法: 每见一个关系词/从属连词就断开, 标注它修饰哪个名词或连接哪个分句, 再按主从关系搭回骨架。长句不是读不懂, 是没拆干净。

q: 因为下雨, 我没有出门。哪种英文正确?
o: Because it rained, I did not go out.;;Because it rained, so I did not go out.;;It because rained, so I did not go out.;;So it rained because I did not go out.
e: 中文连词成对出现, 英文只留一个: because 与 so 不能同句。同类: 虽然…但是(although/but)、因为…所以。仍可用逗号 + still 加强语气。

q: 虽然他很累, 他还是继续工作。地道写法是?
o: Although he was tired, he kept on working.;;Although he was tired, but he kept on working.;;He was tired, but although he kept working.;;He was tired although but he kept working.
e: although/though 与 but 二选一。想两句都保留可改成 He was tired, but he still kept on working。注意 though 可与 still 同现, but 不行。

q: 我们要不断学习新知识。最地道的英文是?
o: We should keep acquiring new knowledge.;;We should keep learning new knowledges.;;We should study a new knowledge.;;We should gain a knowledge.
e: knowledge 不可数: 不加 a, 没有复数 knowledges。地道搭配 acquire/gain knowledge。learn 多接语言、技能(learn English / learn to swim)。

q: 这房子价格很高。正确说法是?
o: The price of the house is high.;;The price of the house is expensive.;;The house is expensive in price high.;;The price of the house is costly.
e: 贵的是房子(The house is expensive), 价格只能说高低(The price is high/low)。中文「价格贵」直译是最典型的 Chinglish, 四级翻译题常设此坑。

q: 我爷爷身体很好。地道说法是?
o: My grandfather is in good health.;;My grandfather's body is very good.;;My grandfather is a healthy body.;;My grandfather has good body.
e: 英文不直译「身体好」。用 be in good health / be well / be fit。body 指躯体或身体部位, 不说 body is good。

q: 他整天玩手机。哪种说法自然?
o: He spends all day on his phone.;;He plays his phone all day.;;He watches his phone all day.;;He games his phone all day.
e: play 不能直接接 phone(玩弄某物才说 play with the phone)。地道: spend time on one's phone / be glued to one's phone(机不离眼)。

q: 那次旅行让我大开眼界。正确表达是?
o: The trip really broadened my horizons.;;The trip made my eyes open big.;;The trip opened my eyes wide up.;;The trip let me see the world mouth.
e: 开阔眼界 = broaden/widen one's horizons(常用复数)。open one's eyes 要接 to: opened my eyes to the world(让我看清世界)。其余三项都是把中文逐字直译, 英文里不这么说。

q: 朋友比赛前, 你想对他说「加油」。最合适的英文是?
o: You can do it!;;Add oil!;;Please fight for your life.;;Give you oil.
e: 加油 不能直译 add oil(网络用语, 正式写作算错)。地道鼓励: You can do it / Good luck / Keep it up / Go for it。Fighting 单独用也是中式英语。

q: 客人进门时你说「欢迎」。正确说法是?
o: Welcome!;;Welcome you!;;You are welcomed to come in.;;Welcome to come in.
e: welcome 作感叹词单独使用: Welcome! / Welcome to our home。不接宾语(you), 也没有 Welcome to do 的说法。Welcome back 欢迎回来。

q: 外面雨下得很大。正确说法是?
o: It is raining heavily outside.;;It is raining bigly outside.;;The rain is very big outside.;;It rains large outside.
e: 雨大用 rain heavily 或 rain hard。big/large 形容体积或规模, 不修饰雨量。风大同理: The wind is strong / blow hard。

q: 她会在聚会上弹吉他。按四级规范, 正确的是?
o: She will play the guitar at the party.;;She will play a guitar at the party.;;She will play guitar football at the party.;;She will play the football at the party.
e: 乐器前加 the: play the guitar/piano; 球类、棋类前不加 the: play basketball / play chess。选项 D 把 the 加在 football 上是典型错误。

q: 我希望明天天气好。正确说法是?
o: I hope the weather will be fine tomorrow.;;I wish the weather will be fine tomorrow.;;I hope would be fine tomorrow.;;I wish to be fine tomorrow.
e: hope 表可能实现的愿望, 可接将来时(hope + will)。wish 表难以实现的愿望, 从句要用过去式虚拟; wish 也不能接 sb to do 表希望(只用于祝愿: Wish you a merry Christmas)。

q: 抱歉让你久等了。地道说法是?
o: Sorry to keep you waiting.;;Sorry to let you waiting.;;Sorry for your long wait make.;;Sorry to keep you to wait.
e: keep sb doing 让某人一直做着某事(强调持续)。let/make/have sb do 用动词原形, 不能接 waiting, 也不能接 to wait。

q: 我对通过考试很有信心。正确的是?
o: I am confident of passing the exam.;;I have confidence to pass the exam is big.;;I am confidence of passing the exam.;;I feel my confidence pass the exam.
e: confident 是形容词(be confident of/about + 名词或动名词), confidence 是名词(可说 I have great confidence in...)。中式英语常把 confident 与 confidence 混用或给形容词加 very much。

q: 他比我高得多。He is ___ taller than I am.
e: 比较级可用 much/far/a lot/still/even 修饰; very/quite/rather 只能修饰原级(very tall)。中文「得多」对应 much/far taller, 用 very taller 是常见错。

q: ___ , an increasing number of students are addicted to their phones.
e: Nowadays / These days 起笔交代时代背景, 是作文第一段万能开头。an increasing number of + 复数名词, 谓语用复数(比较: a number of 复数, the number of 单数)。

q: ___ the rapid development of the Internet, online learning has become part of daily life.
e: With the development of... 随着…的发展, 是书面套语。Along with 也可表伴随但要接具体名词(Along with the Internet); By/Under the development 不成立。

q: Some people ___ that reading books is useless in the digital age.
e: 表观点的高级动词: argue / hold / maintain / believe that...。discuss 与 talk 不及物时不能直接接 that 从句(discuss sth, talk about sth)。

q: 下面哪个表达「在我看来」不适合写进作文?
o: In my mind;;In my opinion;;From my perspective;;As far as I am concerned
e: In my mind 是中式直译。地道书面表达: in my opinion / from my perspective / as far as I am concerned / it seems to me that / I am convinced that。

q: Many campus activities benefit students, ___ the volunteer program.
o: for instance;;on the contrary;;in a word;;on the whole
e: for instance 与 such as 都表举例: 逗号后接名词短语两者皆可, 但 for instance 还能独立引导一句(For instance, the volunteer program...)。on the contrary 表相反, in a word 表总结。

q: According to a survey, 70 percent of the students ___ less than half an hour on exercise daily.
e: 人 spend time/money on sth; 物作主语用 cost(It costs 500 yuan); it takes sb time to do sth; pay 要配 for。图表作文里 spend...on 与 account for 是两句骨干。

q: 解释根本原因, 哪种写法规范?
o: The underlying reason for this is that jobs demand practical skills.;;The reason of this is because jobs demand skills.;;This is because the reason that jobs demand skills.;;Because the reason is this jobs demand skills.
e: The reason is that... 不能用 because(The reason...is because 是典型错误)。underlying reason 根本原因, 比 main reason 更书面。

q: ___ it is true that online courses are flexible, they lack face-to-face interaction.
e: while 放句首表让步(虽然), 是议论文加分句型。since 表既然/因为, unless 表除非, once 表一旦。也可写 It is true that..., but they lack...。

q: 与前文相反: ___ , rural areas still have a low Internet coverage rate.
o: By contrast;;In the contrast;;On contrast;;By the contrasting
e: By contrast / In contrast 相比之下(句首加逗号)。要接比较对象时用 in contrast to/with sth。没有 on contrast 与 the contrast 的说法。

q: Smartphones ___ a great impact on students' study habits.
e: have/exert an impact(effect/influence) on 对…有影响, 动词只能用 have 或 exert。中文「产生影响」易误译成 make an impact。

q: 英语 ___ a vital role in international communication.
e: play a vital/important/key role in 在…中起关键作用; 也可写 be vital to。同类: play a part in, hold the key to。

q: It is high time that universities ___ their libraries to all students.
e: It is (high) time that + 主语 + 过去式, 表早该做而没做(虚拟)。也可写 It is imperative for universities to open..., 后者更适合结尾建议段。

q: ___ , campus open spaces benefit both study and health.
o: To sum up;;To say;;In a word of;;At the sum
e: 结尾归纳: To sum up / In conclusion / To conclude / In short / All in all。In a word 也正确但不能加 of。

q: Only by protecting wild animals ___ our own habitat safe.
o: can we keep;;we can keep;;keep we;;can keep we
e: Only by doing 置句首→主句部分倒装(can/could/do/did 提到主语前)。作文结尾用一次倒装(Only in this way can we...)是最容易拿分的亮点句。

q: It is the process of learning ___ really matters, not the grade.
e: 强调句 It is...that..., 被强调部分是物(the process)→that; 强调人时可用 who。写作里用强调句突出关键词, 比平铺直叙有力。

q: ___ the final exam approaching, many students stay up late every night.
e: with + 名词 + 现在分词 构成伴随/原因状语(独立主格式写法), 是句式多样性的加分点。若用 as 则必须接完整从句: As the exam is approaching...。

q: 下面哪一句表达「这个问题值得关注」是错的?
o: The problem deserves to immediate attention.;;The problem deserves immediate attention.;;The problem is worth our attention.;;Attention should be paid to the problem.
e: deserve 后接名词(deserve attention)或不定式(deserve to be discussed), 不能 deserve to + 名词。pay attention to 变被动时 to 仍接名词: Attention should be paid to it。

q: The number of readers ___ from 1,200 in 2020 to 3,500 in 2024.
o: rose sharply;;was risen sharply;;rose sharp;;has been raising
e: rise 不及物、没有被动; 描述已结束的年度区间(2020-2024)用一般过去时; 修饰动词用副词 sharply。同类: climb/soar/shoot up 上升, drop/decline 下降, remain stable 持平。

q: ___ , everyone should take part in garbage sorting.
o: Ultimately;;Eventually it is said;;In the final of;;At lastly
e: 收尾副词: Ultimately / In the end / Therefore / Thus。Ultimately 更书面, 适合最后一段第一句引出倡议。

q: 写作易错点: Not only the students but also the teacher ___ invited to the hall.
e: not only...but also 连接两个主语时谓语就近, 靠近谓语的是 the teacher(单数)+过去语境→was。另注意 Not only 置句首时前一分句要部分倒装: Not only were the students...。
